tagline: Start your business, step by step.
brief: A free, mobile-first guide that tells a first-time founder in Bangladesh exactly what to do, in what order, to start a small business. Playful, soft, warm — paper, torn edges, Chillax.
criteria: Success: distinct from generic startup marks, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, feels like paper and growth.

concepts.name: Sprout (chosen)
concepts.idea: A single seed splitting open into a small shoot — 'start' as growth.
rationale: Growth metaphor ties to the product's promise
Each colour owns a job from the Hum palette
Works in one colour (black master) and at 16 px (favicon cut)

recommendation: Sprout — the only concept with a single clear ownable idea that isn't a generic step/path metaphor.
next_steps: Generate PNG/icon set with a renderer (cairosvg/inkscape/chrome)
